name: Broad Capital Acquisition Corp
summary: Broad Capital Acquisition Corp is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. It is a shell corporation that has no operations. Once it identifies a target company, the SPAC and the target merge, and the target company becomes publicly traded.
